scope: Independent finalizer source inspection plus read-only package verification and an in-memory metadata rejection check; no new model or operating solve
reviewed_guards: Required construction, classification, runtime and adapter receipts must pass and their current dependency hashes must match.
Operating receipt scope retains failed attempts, excludes full-year feasibility and excludes global infeasibility claims.
Independent whole-network audit confirms all eight attempts and four successful-point ACPF replays without claiming temperature equilibrium.
Public default API smoke receipt is required in addition to component tests.
Prior P34 and Dover delivery files are checked against their preserved manifests without rerunning earlier simulations.
Contract retains unresolved composite interiors, synthetic equipment status and fixed-reference-temperature limitations.
Verify mode compares the entire expected delivery manifest including qualification metadata and file hashes.
Verify mode only reads files and prints results; seal mode writes the contract and manifest.
The delivery manifest excludes itself from package hash coverage.
The report review checks the delivery-manifest link for existence only, avoiding a circular hash dependency.
